description: Synthetic pairing of solar and load test-set predictions. For each unique (hour, month) key present in both datasets, one solar row and one load row are randomly sampled (seed=42). The resulting pairs are a SYNTHETIC DECISION REFERENCE, not real-world co-located measurements.
duplicate_handling: Random sample of 1 per (hour, month) key; no duplicates.
load_source: UCI Household Electric Power Consumption, Sceaux France (2006-2010)
